'''Kamtis Bonai''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]], who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
The [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] band Bonai was part of once worked for the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Thaum Rystra]]. However, Rystra captured Bonai and some of the other pirates and took them back to the [[Temple of Pain]], a [[Sith temple/Legends|Sith Temple]] built inside an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] located in the [[Tascollan Nebula/Legends|Tascollan Nebula]]. Rystra practiced [[Sith alchemy/Legends|Sith alchemy]] on them all and Bonai looked no different than he had before, although he had a maniacal look in his eyes.
